roles.formation_and_warmup: 2024-03-01T00:00:00Z through 2025-07-31T23:59:59.999999999Z, with each refit consuming only its frozen 365-day training, 90-day validation, two one-hour purges, 168-hour endpoint history, and causal 720-hour hedge/risk history
roles.terminal_execution: 2026-06-30T23:00:00Z is an observed June open used only as a zero-target liquidation boundary; no July 2026 archive, open, funding event, decision, or return may be requested

warmup_proof_required_before_preparation.rule: the preparation receipt must recompute and record the exact first training, validation, test, endpoint-history, hedge-history, and risk-history timestamps; any insufficiency hard-fails

separation.forecast_stage_input: one blinded fold artifact per refit and representation; contains train/validation labels and causal histories available before each test decision, but no same-decision forward cashflow label, next-boundary funding, cost, IC, or portfolio outcome array
separation.evaluation_stage_input: separate content-addressed economic/execution payload; it is not passed to the training process and cannot be opened until the 32-artifact all-fold forecast seal verifies
